name: nav
title: Nav
description: Vertical (or wrapping) location list; the cobalt band stretches between items. Labelled groups, icon key cells, nested links under a disclosure, row actions (NavAction), a brand identity block and a footer; a rail of key cells with tooltips inside AppShell. With AppShell it is the sidebar (@keyline-ui/sidebar).
whenToUse: Use it for an application's sections in a sidebar, with the current one marked. For a website's top navigation use Navigation menu; for views of one place use Tabs.

parts.name: Nav
parts.description: App location. A region frame holding a list of items; the current item is under a cobalt band that STRETCHES between items, vertically in a sidebar and horizontally once the layout turns it into a row (axis follows the list's flex direction). Items are links (`href`) or buttons; current = aria-current. - `groups` label sections (a list per group, named by its label); the band crosses between them. - `icon` puts a glyph in a key cell at the item's start; in AppShell's rail only the key cells show and the label flies out beside the item on hover and on keyboard focus (it stays the accessible name). - `footer` sits at the bottom of the column.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned to the bottom of the nav (who is signed in, a workspace, settings).

props.name: groups
props.description: Labelled sections, separated by a heavy seam; one cobalt band still runs across all of them.

props.name: items
props.description: Flat list of items. Or pass `groups`.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description: What renders an `href` item. Default `"a"` (a full page load). Pass your router's link, such as Next's `Link`, so items navigate client-side; it receives the anchor's props (href, className, onClick, aria-*).

props.name: orientation
props.description: responsive: vertical while the nav is narrower than 300px, a row when wider (container query).

parts.name: NavAction
parts.description: The ⋯ key cell of a row action: pass it as a MenuTrigger's render, so the item's commands open in a Menu docked to the row. `label` names it ("More for Saved view: Late arrivals").

props.name: label
props.description: Names the cell ("More for Saved view: Late arrivals").

parts.name: NavIdentity
parts.description: A header or footer identity for a sidebar Nav: a square mark cell, then a title and a meta line (a site code, a role). On a rail only the mark shows; the title and meta stay in the accessibility tree.
